_comment: Upstream versions and the build number of the archives published for each.
The build number exists because a change to our build flags reissues an
archive without the upstream version moving, which is how the release tags
macos_deployment_target is the oldest macOS the archives may require. It
must not exceed the target of the wheels that link them.
This is the only place any of these is written. The build scripts, the
CMake fetch, and the release workflow all read it.
